svg.desc: Horizontal bars show mean complete-law total variation on 1,152 primary slots: R 0.054913, S 0.054918, E 0.116210, G 0.395816, B 0.064684, P 0.099072, O 0.152015, H 0.986652. Lower is better; these are finite descriptive scores without population confidence bars.
